title: Requiem of the Rose King
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A dark historical fantasy loosely based on Shakespeare's Henry VI plays and Richard III, set during England's Wars of the Roses. Richard, third son of the House of York, believes he is cursed from birth; database tags describe him as intersex and hiding it. As his father's bid for the throne ends in death, Richard is drawn into revenge, succession struggles and doomed relationships on a path toward personal destruction.
life_message: Ambition, revenge and a sense of being cursed can consume a person; the tragedy asks whether fate or choice leads to ruin.
